    "index", "term", "op", "key", "value", "client_id", "request_id",
    "committed_at_ns", "prev_hash", "hash",
]

ledger_df = pd.DataFrame(
    [{
        "index": e.index, "term": e.term, "op": e.txn.op, "key": e.txn.key,
        "value": e.txn.value.decode() if e.txn.value is not None else None,
        "client_id": e.txn.client_id, "request_id": e.txn.request_id,
        "committed_at_ns": e.committed_at_ns,
        "prev_hash": e.prev_hash[:12], "hash": e.hash[:12],
    } for e in svc.entries],
    columns=TRANSACTION_HISTORY_COLUMNS,
)

for _, row in committed_ops.iterrows():
    idx = int(row["index"])
    e = svc.read(idx)
    if e is None or e.txn.request_id != row["request_id"]:
